name: box2d3wasm
description: A standalone web page: an index.html that builds this scene and runs it on a canvas. Where the engine comes from is a setting -- built into the page, beside it, or from a CDN.

settings.label: Project name
settings.tooltip: The page title. Letters, digits and underscores.

settings.label: Engine
settings.tooltip: Where the page gets Box2D. Built in, it is part of index.html and the page opens straight from a file with no server and no network. Beside the page, it is a second file next to it, which is smaller to reload and still needs no server. From a CDN, neither is written and the page fetches it, which needs both.

settings.label: CDN address
settings.tooltip: The module the page imports when Engine is From a CDN. Ignored otherwise. The version has to be the one this converter was built against, or the page will call things that are not there.

settings.label: Add controls
settings.tooltip: Start, Pause and Stop buttons above the canvas. Without them the page opens running and there is nothing to press.

settings.label: Debug view
settings.tooltip: Adds a Debug view switch to the controls: joints, each body's centre of mass and heading, and where the rays are looking, drawn over the scene.

settings.label: Pan and zoom
settings.tooltip: Drag the canvas to move the view and use the wheel to zoom, the way the editor's own canvas works. Without it the page shows a fixed view of the field.

settings.label: Steps per second
settings.tooltip: How often the exported page steps the world. The editor's own setting is not carried across, since it is a preference rather than part of the scene.

settings.label: Sub-steps
settings.tooltip: How many times Box2D relaxes the constraints within one step. The scene's own value is used when it has one; this is the fallback.
